name: American Black Bear
summary: A bear of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Shrewsbury SM-69.
DayOne groups bears with the larger or more dangerous animals best shot from a distance.
Push Square says Bret collects large carcasses such as bears himself.

facts.menu_text: Omnivorous and adept at swimming and climbing, the American black bear is at home in a range of habitats, typically favoring forested areas, and is best engaged from a distance.

name: American Crocodile
summary: A crocodile found on the coast that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Coastal and recommends the Shrewsbury SM-69.

facts.menu_text: The American crocodile is the largest reptile in Leonida. More comfortable in salt water than an alligator, it can be most commonly sighted in tropical regions and should be engaged from a safe distance.

name: American Red Fox
summary: A fox of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Hawk & Little Mediator.

facts.menu_text: Larger than its gray cousins and bearing a white tip on its tail, the American red fox is non-native to Leonida. Found in northern forested areas, it should be hunted with a low-power rifle.

name: Blue Axanthic Iguana
summary: A rare bright-blue iguana found in coastal and urban areas of the warm south.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Coastal, Urban and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: This rare iguana lacks any red or yellow pigment in its scales, making it a striking electric blue. It prefers warmer, southern regions including urban centers with a source of fresh water. A low-power rifle will take it down in one piece.

name: Box Turtle
summary: A small turtle found in most habitats that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Coastal, Forest, Urban, Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: The box turtle is found across Leonida, but is especially common in wetlands, and is named for its ability to seal up its hinged shell like a protective box. Hunters should use restraint or risk destroying the carcass.

name: Eastern Cottontail Rabbit
summary: A rabbit of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: The eastern cottontail rabbit is found in most regions of Leonida, and is easily recognized by its fluffy white tail. They're quick to flee and hard to catch, but a low- power rifle will take them down in one piece.

name: Eastern Spotted Skunk
summary: A night-active skunk found in forests, towns and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Urban, Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.
Push Square says it is nocturnal, appeared after about 8pm in grassy areas, and is a target in Bret's second deck, Hog Endocrine Glands (Adler Creek, Bonanza, Mount Kalaga National Park).

facts.menu_text: Named for its distinctive black and white coat, the eastern spotted skunk is nocturnal, adaptable, and has spread all over the region. Hunt with restraint, or risk destroying the carcass.

name: Gray Fox
summary: A fox of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Hawk & Little Mediator.

facts.menu_text: The gray fox makes its home throughout Leonida, and can be recognized by its mottled gray and tan fur. Hunt with a low-power rifle to preserve the carcass.

name: Leonida Bobcat
summary: A wild cat of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Hawk & Little Mediator.

facts.menu_text: The Leonida bobcat prowls the forests in search of prey between dusk and dawn, and can be recognized by its shaggy, mottled coat. Naturally shy but dangerous if cornered, it is safest to hunt from a distance.

name: Leonida Cottonmouth
summary: A snake of coastal and wetland areas that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Coastal, Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: The Leonida cottonmouth is a highly venomous snake found in the wetlands, and is recognizable by the dark bands running around its thick body. Hunters should use restraint for best results.

name: Leonida Wild Turkey
summary: A wild turkey of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetlands and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: A large turkey commonly found in Leonida's forested areas and grassy lowlands. A gentle kill will preserve the quality of the carcass.

name: Leonida Wild White Tom
summary: An uncommon white-feathered wild turkey that Bret asks for in his second Target Deck.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetlands and recommends the Wortham W-22.
Push Square says it is found in grassy or forested areas and that Bret only accepts the white-feathered kind; deck areas are Adler Creek, Bonanza and Mount Kalaga National Park.

facts.menu_text: An uncommon, white-feathered variant of the Leonida wild turkey. Occasionally spotted around Leonida's forested areas and grassy lowlands, and best hunted with a low-power rifle.

name: Mosaic Mottled Duck
summary: A rare colour form of the mottled duck seen around fresh water in the wetlands.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: A rare, colored variant of the more common mottled duck, sometimes sighted on bodies of fresh water around Leonida. A gentle kill will preserve the quality of the carcass.

name: Nile Monitor
summary: A large wetland lizard that can be hunted and is asked for in Bret's third Target Deck.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.
Push Square lists it in Bret's third deck, Cane Toad Venom Glands, with marked areas West Buckskin Swamp, East Buckskin Swamp and Pelican Valley.

facts.menu_text: Leonida's Nile monitor population owes its existence to escaped or released pets that found a home in the region's wetlands. One of the world's largest lizards, a low-power rifle will put it down clean, but its tough skin makes headshots all the more important.

name: Northern Coyote
summary: A coyote of the forests and wetlands that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Hawk & Little Mediator.

facts.menu_text: The ever-adaptable northern coyote prowls Leonida's forests and wetlands. It is recognizable by its red-gray fur and large ears, and tends to gather in packs. Hunters are advised to take it on at long range.

name: Nutria
summary: A wetland rodent that can be hunted and is asked for in Bret's third Target Deck.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.
Push Square lists it in Bret's third deck, Cane Toad Venom Glands, with marked areas West Buckskin Swamp, East Buckskin Swamp and Pelican Valley.

facts.menu_text: A semi-aquatic mammal resembling a large rat, the invasive nutria can be sighted in Leonida's wetlands. Hunters using overpowered weapons risk ruining the carcass.

name: Piebald Whitetail Buck
summary: A rare, unusually coloured whitetail buck seen now and then in forests and wetlands.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Forest, Wetland and recommends the Shrewsbury SM-69.

facts.menu_text: Although rare, this piebald variant of the more common whitetail buck can occasionally be seen grazing in forested areas and wetlands. Skittish, and best hunted at long range.

name: Round-Tailed Muskrat
summary: A small wetland rodent that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: A small rodent found in the wetlands and near sources of fresh water, the round-tailed muskrat is semi-aquatic, and can be recognized by its compact body and long, scaly tail. A gentle kill will preserve the quality of the carcass.

name: Snapping Turtle
summary: A wetland turtle that can be hunted.
body: DayOne lists it among the huntable animals with key habitats Wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22.

facts.menu_text: The snapping turtle is an ambush predator that lurks in the wetlands. Famous for its fast, bone-crushing bite, hunters should use restraint or risk destroying the carcass.

name: Whitetail Buck
summary: The Whitetail Buck is one of the two animals Bret asks for in his first Target Deck.
body: Push Square says Bret's first deck, Adrenal Glands and Venison, needs a Whitetail Buck and a Whitetail Doe.
Push Square says both are found in forested areas or near streams, are easily startled, and are marked at Mount Kalaga National Park and the Abandoned Concrete Plant.
Push Square's writer used a Shrewsbury SM-69 at long range for a clean headshot.

facts.habitat: Forested areas and near streams; Mount Kalaga National Park, Abandoned Concrete Plant

name: Whitetail Doe
summary: The Whitetail Doe is one of the two animals Bret asks for in his first Target Deck.
body: Push Square says Bret's first deck, Adrenal Glands and Venison, needs a Whitetail Buck and a Whitetail Doe.
Push Square says both are found in forested areas or near streams, are easily startled, and are marked at Mount Kalaga National Park and the Abandoned Concrete Plant.
Push Square's writer used a Shrewsbury SM-69 at long range for a clean headshot.

facts.habitat: Forested areas and near streams; Mount Kalaga National Park, Abandoned Concrete Plant

name: Parrotfish
summary: The Parrotfish is a fish Cal asks the player to catch early in the game, at a weight above 2 kg.
body: Push Square's trophy guide says Cal's request is to land a Parrotfish over 2kg in an area marked on the map, and that a boat with a fishing rod is needed.
PowerPyx reports the Progress database counts 35 fish; no page read lists the others.

Sportskeeda's walkthrough of Catch a Bigger Fish says Cal's photo shows a stoplight parrotfish and that the goal is to land one heavier than 2 lbs; Push Square gives the target as over 2kg, so the two guides disagree on the unit.

IGN's GTA 6 fishing guide (updated November 19, 2026) lists the Stoplight Parrotfish among the 35 fish in the Animals Collection, caught with the Small Saltwater Lure, and recommends the southeast of the Shoeless Keys in Mariana County.
IGN's guide now names all 35 fish, which settles the app's note that no page listed the others; each has its own entry.

facts.habitat: Marked fishing area for Cal's challenge, reached by boat
